info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Pro — AI Assistant
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Pro — AI Assistant.** AI assistant and provider gateway: chat and generation, admin configuration, budgets and usage, prompt library, consent, redaction, audit and MCP.

get.summary: pro-ai plugin status / health probe

200.description: Plugin identity, health, and how the credential-vault KEK was sourced.

get.summary: Org AI egress posture: residency mode, no-non-EU guarantee, per-provider reachability

200.description: The effective residency mode, whether non-EU egress is structurally impossible, and per provider whether routing can ever reach it (residency gate + consent).

post.summary: Streaming chat completion (SSE; supports tool calls)
post.description: Server-Sent Events, **not** a JSON body — so the standard `{ data }` envelope does not apply and no typed response schema is declared. `Content-Type: text/event-stream`; each event is `data: <ChatChunk JSON>`, where a chunk carries `delta` / `toolCalls` / `finishReason` / `usage` / `model`. The FIRST chunk carries only `provenance` (IMP-AI-07: which provider, residency, model, and whether the payload was redacted) before any tokens flow. The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`; a mid-stream failure emits `event: error` with `{ message }` and then closes.

201.description: Success. JSON responses are wrapped in the standard envelope: `{ "data": ... }`, with optional `meta` (e.g. pagination) on list endpoints.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Create embeddings

201.description: One vector per input, with the model, dimensionality, token usage, and provenance.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Translate text / rich-text inline, or enqueue a content-wide batch job

201.description: Translations keyed by target locale — `translations` for plain text, `richTextTranslations` for ProseMirror docs. A request carrying `contentId` instead returns only `jobId`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Writing assistant action (improve/fix/shorten/… → diff preview, never auto-applied)

201.description: The suggestion plus the original text for a diff preview. List actions (`headline`, `social`) also return `suggestions`.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Schema-grounded draft of a content item (validated against its JSON Schema)

201.description: The generated payload with its AJV validation verdict. `valid: false` still returns the last attempt's output plus the errors, so the caller may re-prompt — never persist it as-is.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Image → alt text / caption / OCR / tags / description

201.description: The generated text for the requested vision action, with model, usage, and provenance.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Audio/video → text (needs a transcribe-capable provider)

201.description: The transcript, with the model, detected language, usage, and provenance.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Classify (topic/sentiment) or extract entities/fields from text

201.description: Scored labels for topic/sentiment; for `task: 'extract'` an empty `labels` array plus the `extracted` field map.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Semantic search over the org embedding index (IMP-AI-03; query embedded local-first)

200.description: Hits ranked by cosine similarity, plus the provenance of the query-embedding call.

get.summary: "More like this": rank org content by similarity to a stored item (no inference)

200.description: Hits ranked by cosine similarity to the stored vector. No `provenance` — this is a pure index lookup with no model call. Empty when the item is not indexed yet.

get.summary: Advisory near-duplicate candidates for an indexed item (stored vector — no inference)

200.description: Advisory candidates and the effective cosine threshold. No `provenance` — the stored vector is reused, so no inference runs.

post.summary: Advisory near-duplicate candidates for a draft / imported payload (digest embedded)

201.description: Advisory candidates, the effective cosine threshold, and the provenance of the draft-embedding call. Nothing is ever blocked automatically.

post.summary: Advisory safety/PII pass (local-first by default; never blocks on its own)

201.description: Scored category flags, the PII match count, the applied threshold, and the org `enforcement` policy the caller should apply. Advisory — this endpoint never blocks.

post.summary: Schema-constrained facet suggestions for an item or draft (local-first; human confirms)

201.description: Selected facet values plus the content type's allowed vocabulary. Selections are hard-filtered to the vocabulary, so free-text drift is impossible.

post.summary: Draft teaser fields conforming to the type teaser schema (framed, validated, local-first)

201.description: The drafted teaser with its AJV verdict. `valid: false` still returns the last attempt plus the errors — a human confirms via diff either way.

post.summary: Submit a batch job (bulk translate, embed backfill)

201.description: The enqueued job id; poll `GET /pro/ai/jobs/{id}` for progress and output.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get an AI batch job (e.g. content-wide translate)

200.description: The `pro_ai_jobs` row, scoped to the caller's organization.

get.summary: List AI providers (org-shared + caller BYO); secrets masked

200.description: Providers ordered by priority then creation time, annotated with `residencyAllowed` / `retentionBlocked`. The vaulted API key is never returned — only the masked `keyHint`.

post.summary: Create an AI provider (key vaulted)

201.description: The created provider. `residencyAllowed` / `retentionBlocked` are absent here — they are computed only by the list endpoint.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

put.summary: Update an AI provider (rotates key if provided)

200.description: The updated provider, with the masked key hint after any rotation.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Delete an AI provider (purges vaulted key)

200.description: Deleted (the vaulted key is revoked first). The service returns no payload, so the envelope carries no `data` — the body is `{}`.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

post.summary: Health-check a provider

201.description: Probe result from the provider adapter — reachability, latency, and queue depth.

get.summary: Get the per-org task→model routing config

200.description: The stored route table, or `{}` when none is configured.

data.description: The per-org route table (`pro_ai_routes.config`): task name → routing entry. Task keys are open ('chat', 'embed', 'translate', 'writeAssist', 'generateStructured', 'vision', 'transcribe', 'classify', 'moderate', 'suggestFacets', 'summarizeForTeaser', 'dedup', …); `{}` when the org has never saved a config.

200.description: The saved route table, echoed back verbatim.

data.description: The per-org route table (`pro_ai_routes.config`): task name → routing entry. Task keys are open ('chat', 'embed', 'translate', 'writeAssist', 'generateStructured', 'vision', 'transcribe', 'classify', 'moderate', 'suggestFacets', 'summarizeForTeaser', 'dedup', …); `{}` when the org has never saved a config.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: List prompts (org + global defaults)

200.description: Org-owned prompts and shipped global defaults (`organization_id: null`), ordered by key, locale, then version descending.

post.summary: Create a prompt (new version of key+locale)

201.description: The stored prompt, with the `version` the server assigned (previous max + 1).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Seed missing global default prompts

201.description: How many shipped default prompts were inserted. Idempotent — `0` on a re-run.

post.summary: Resolve + render a prompt (preview)

201.description: The rendered template (org override wins over the global default, requested locale over `en`, highest version). `text` is null when no template matches the key.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Get a prompt by id

200.description: The prompt row (org-owned or a global default).

delete.summary: Delete an org-owned prompt (global defaults protected)

200.description: Deleted. The service returns no payload, so the envelope carries no `data` — the body is `{}`. A global default (or an unknown id) yields 404 instead.

meta.description: Optional metadata (pagination, counts) — present on list endpoints

get.summary: List the org redaction rules

200.description: Stored rules (enabled and disabled), ordered by `applies_to` then id. Empty when the org has configured none — the built-in default (emails/phones/IBANs, cloud-only) is then active at call time but is not listed until `seed-defaults` materializes it.

post.summary: Create a custom redaction rule (advanced governance — Business)

201.description: Only the new rule id — re-read `GET /pro/ai/redaction` for the stored row.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

post.summary: Materialize the default redaction rule (if none exist)

201.description: `inserted: 1` when the built-in default rule was written, `0` when the org already had rules. Idempotent.

200.description: How many rules were removed — `0` when the id did not match in this org.

get.summary: List consent records (active + revoked)

200.description: Every consent row for the org, newest first, of **all** classes (both `cloud_egress` and `retention_override`). A record is active while `revoked_at` is null.

post.summary: Grant consent for a non-EU provider type

201.description: `granted: true` when a new `cloud_egress` consent was recorded; `false` when an active consent already existed (no-op).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

delete.summary: Revoke consent for a provider type

200.description: How many active `cloud_egress` consents were stamped as revoked.

get.summary: List zero-retention override acknowledgements

200.description: Consent rows of class `retention_override` only, newest first (same table and shape as the cloud-egress ledger).

post.summary: Acknowledge an override to use a non-zero-retention cloud provider in eu_only (advanced governance — Business)

201.description: `granted: true` when a new `retention_override` acknowledgement was recorded; `false` when one was already active.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: How many active `retention_override` acknowledgements were stamped as revoked.

get.summary: Query the AI audit log (metadata + hashes, never raw text)

200.description: A self-contained page object (`rows`/`total`/`page`/`perPage`) — this endpoint does **not** use the platform `{ data, meta }` pagination. Rows carry prompt/output sha256 hashes and a `has_raw` flag, never the raw text.

get.summary: GDPR export of audit records (optionally for one user)

200.description: Up to 10 000 rows, newest first. Unlike the audit query this **includes** `raw_prompt` / `raw_output` — the data subject's own text — which are NULL unless the org's time-boxed retention window still covers the row.

get.summary: Get the raw-text retention window status

200.description: When the raw-retention window closes, or null when it is closed (the default).

put.summary: Open/close the time-boxed raw-text retention window (advanced governance — Business)

200.description: The new deadline — `rawRetentionUntil` is now + `rawRetentionHours`, or null when the window was closed (`disable: true` or no hours given).

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Usage dashboard (tokens/cost by caller/model/day + counts)

200.description: Aggregation over `pro_ai_usage_log` for the window (default: last 30 days) — totals plus per-caller, per-model, and per-day buckets.

get.summary: List org + per-user budgets (burn-down)

200.description: All budgets for the org (org-shared rows first, then per-user), with their limits and current period spend.
Only the budget id — the id sent in the request when updating, or the newly inserted id. Re-read `GET /pro/ai/budgets` for the stored row.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

200.description: How many budget rows were removed — `0` when the id did not match in this org.

get.summary: List the AI capabilities exposed as MCP tools

200.description: The static tool catalog (`ai_translate`, `ai_summarize`, `ai_classify`, `ai_extract`, `ai_alt_text`) with each tool's JSON Schema and consent class.

post.summary: Invoke an AI MCP tool through the governed gateway

201.description: The dispatched gateway result. Its shape depends on `tool`, so it is documented as an open object rather than a single schema: `ai_translate` → `ProAiTranslateResponseDto`, `ai_summarize` → `ProAiWriteAssistResponseDto`, `ai_classify` / `ai_extract` → `ProAiClassifyResponseDto`, `ai_alt_text` → `ProAiVisionResponseDto` (all documented under the `pro-ai` tag). An unknown tool name yields 400.

400.description: Validation failed — the request body does not match the documented schema (unknown properties are rejected).

get.summary: Admin-UI translations for a locale (ngx-translate http-loader)

200.description: A flat translation catalog: message key → translated string (keys are dotted, e.g. `page.title`, `tab.providers`). Documented as an open string map because the key set is the catalog itself, not a fixed schema. The body is the map itself — this route is exempt from the `{ data }` envelope so ngx-translate can consume it directly. Unknown locales return `{}` so ngx-translate falls back to `en`. Cached for 24 h.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

errors.description: Present on 422 content-validation failures: one entry per rule that failed. Absent otherwise.

path.description: JSON pointer to the offending field

keyword.description: The rule that fired, e.g. required, after_field, before_field, requiredIf, requiredUnless, asset_exists, reference_exists

id.description: Log row id (`BIGSERIAL`). A JSON number while it fits an exact integer, a string beyond 2^53.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 hex of the serialized prompt.

output_hash.description: sha256 hex of the model output.

raw_prompt.description: The raw prompt text, retained only while the org raw-retention window covers this row; NULL otherwise.

raw_output.description: The raw model output, retained under the same window; NULL otherwise.

raw_expires_at.description: When the raw text becomes eligible for the hourly purge.

id.description: Log row id. The column is `BIGSERIAL`; the API serializes it as a JSON **number** while it fits an exact integer, and as a **string** beyond 2^53 so no precision is lost. Deliberately not coerced with `Number()`, which would silently round off the large case.

user_id.description: User the call is attributed to.

provider_type.description: Provider type that served the call.

redacted.description: Whether PII redaction modified the payload.

prompt_hash.description: sha256 hex of the serialized prompt (privacy-preserving; never the text).

output_hash.description: sha256 hex of the model output.

has_raw.description: True when raw prompt/output text is still retained for this row (only inside an open, time-boxed retention window). The raw text itself is not returned by this endpoint.

user_id.description: null = org-shared budget; set = per-user budget.

token_limit.description: Token ceiling (BIGINT); null = no token limit.

cost_limit.description: Cost ceiling (NUMERIC(12,2)); null = no cost limit.

spent_tokens.description: Tokens spent in the current period (BIGINT).

spent_cost.description: Cost spent in the current period (NUMERIC(12,2)).

alert_at_pct.description: Percent of the limit at which admins are alerted.

resets_at.description: When the hourly sweep zeroes spend and advances the period.

labels.description: Classification labels with confidence, highest first. Always an empty array for `task: 'extract'`.

extracted.description: Extracted field/entity map for `task: 'extract'` — keys are the requested `fields` (or whatever entities the model found), so the shape is request-dependent. `{}` when nothing parsed.

consent_class.description: Consent class. 'cloud_egress' = permission to use a non-EU provider; 'retention_override' = acknowledgement to use a non-zero-retention cloud provider in eu_only.

granted_by.description: User id that granted the consent.

revoked_at.description: Set when revoked; a consent is active while this is null.

note.description: Free-text justification recorded with the grant.

granted.description: True when a new consent row was written; false when an active consent already existed.

revoked.description: Number of previously-active consent rows stamped with `revoked_at`.

id.description: UUID of the created (or updated) row.

deleted.description: Number of rows deleted (0 when nothing matched).

contentTypeId.description: Content type id of the hit; null when the content row has none.

lexicalSimilarity.description: Word-shingle Jaccard overlap of the two text digests, when both digests were loadable.

nearExact.description: True for near-verbatim copies (lexical overlap ≥ 0.6) — kept even below the cosine threshold.

residencyMode.description: The org/instance default residency mode (per-task routes may narrow it further).

noNonEuEgress.description: True when the default mode structurally prevents any non-EU egress (`local_only` or `eu_only`) — the "content never leaves the EU" guarantee.

providers.description: Per-provider standing in the org egress posture.

allowedByResidency.description: Whether the active residency mode allows this provider at all.

consented.description: Non-EU providers only: whether the org has granted egress consent.

reachable.description: Whether routing can currently select this provider (residency gate AND consent).

noRetention.description: Whether the endpoint guarantees no training/retention (`pro_ai_providers.no_retention`).

embeddings.description: One vector per input, in input order (a single string input yields one vector).

model.description: Embed model that produced the vectors.

input.description: The submitted job input (JSONB) — its shape depends on `task`.

output.description: The job result (JSONB), written on completion — shape depends on `task`.

created_by.description: User id that submitted the job.

status.description: Always `queued` — the worker picks the job up asynchronously.

rawRetentionUntil.description: Until when raw prompt/output text is retained for this org; null when the window is closed (the default — only hashes are stored).

description.description: Human-readable tool description (also states that input text is untrusted data).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool arguments (the MCP Gateway maps it to Zod). Per-tool shape, so it is documented as an open object.

consentClass.description: MCP consent class, mirroring the gateway's consent ledger.

tools.description: The AI capabilities this plugin exposes as MCP tools.

flags.description: Scored category flags (empty when there was no text to inspect).

reviewRecommended.description: True when any flag is at/above the threshold (PII always is).

piiMatches.description: PII findings in publicly-delivered content — pattern matches in the text digest plus configured `field_paths` that carry a value.

threshold.description: The review threshold applied (request override → per-org route config → 0.5).

enforcement.description: Org escalation policy the caller (publish UI) should apply to flagged content. Advisory by default — this endpoint never blocks on its own.

provenance.description: Absent when no text was inspected (no model call was made).

category.description: Flagged category. Model categories are hate/harassment/sexual/violence/illegal; 'pii_in_public_field' is added by the local PII scan.

candidates.description: Advisory candidates above the effective threshold (or near-verbatim). Nothing is ever blocked or removed automatically — a human confirms.

threshold.description: The cosine threshold actually applied (request override → per-org route-table `dedup` → `AI_DEDUP_THRESHOLD` → 0.9).

provenance.description: Present only on the draft path, where the digest is embedded (an inference ran).

organization_id.description: Owning organization; null = shipped global default (protected from deletion).

version.description: Version within (org, key, locale) — the highest version wins at resolution time.

template.description: The template text; `{{var}}` placeholders are substituted at render time.

signature.description: Optional Ed25519 signature (base64) over the template, for shipped/global prompts.

text.description: The rendered prompt, or null when no template exists for the requested key (unknown placeholders are left intact rather than blanked).

providerType.description: Provider type that served the call (`pro_ai_providers.type`).

residency.description: Mapped data residency of the provider. 'self_hosted' means the call never left the instance.

model.description: Resolved model id that produced the result.

redacted.description: True when PII redaction modified the payload before a cloud call.

fallback.description: True when routing fell back from a higher-priority provider.

baseUrl.description: Endpoint base URL; null when the adapter default is used.

residency.description: Configured data residency of the endpoint.

noRetention.description: Whether the endpoint guarantees no training/retention.

enabled.description: Whether the provider may be selected by routing.

scope.description: 'org' = org-shared provider (`user_id IS NULL`); 'user' = the caller's own BYO key.

keyHint.description: Masked hint for the vaulted API key (never the key itself); null when no key is stored or no hint was recorded.

modelCount.description: Number of models configured for this provider.

residencyAllowed.description: Whether the instance residency mode permits this provider (false = hard-blocked). Set by the list endpoint; absent on single-provider responses.

retentionBlocked.description: True in `eu_only` mode for an allowed cloud provider without `noRetention` and without a zero-retention override — blocked until an override is acknowledged. Set by the list endpoint; absent on single-provider responses.

latencyMs.description: Round-trip latency of the probe in milliseconds.

queueDepth.description: Pending requests, when the backend reports it (e.g. Augmentor / Ollama).

applies_to.description: 'cloud' = redact only when the resolved provider is not self-hosted; 'all' = always redact.

patterns.description: Regex strings matched against outgoing text (invalid patterns are skipped at call time).

field_paths.description: Dot-paths stripped from structured content payloads.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the offending instance location (empty for document-level errors).

message.example: must NOT have more than 110 characters

keyword.description: AJV keyword that failed, or 'json' when the model output was not JSON at all.

inserted.description: Number of rows inserted by this call (0 when everything was already seeded).

contentTypeId.description: Content type id of the hit; null when the content row has none.

hits.description: Hits ordered by descending similarity (max `k`, default 10, capped at 50).

provenance.description: Where the query embedding ran. Present for `GET /pro/ai/search`; absent for `/similar`, which is a pure index lookup with no inference.

vaultKeyMode.description: How the credential-vault KEK was sourced. 'env' = a real key from `PRO_AI_VAULT_KEK`; 'insecure-dev' = the deterministic dev fallback (never in production — the plugin refuses to boot there without a valid KEK).

data.description: The generated content payload, shaped by the content type's JSON Schema (fetched from the Schema Registry sync) — so its properties vary per type and are not fixed here. On a failed run this is the last attempt's output, or the raw model text when it was not JSON at all.

valid.description: Whether `data` validated against the content type's JSON Schema (AJV, 2020-12).

errors.description: AJV errors from the last attempt; present only when `valid` is false.

facets.description: fieldId → selected values. Hard-filtered to `vocabulary[fieldId]`, so free-text drift is impossible. `{}` when the type has no enumerated facets or there was no text.

vocabulary.description: fieldId → the content type's allowed values, extracted from its JSON Schema enums (for the confirm UI).

provenance.description: Absent when no inference was spent (empty vocabulary or no text).

residency.description: Residency mode for this task, narrowing the instance default.

provider.description: Force a provider type as the preferred backend.

fallback.description: Ordered fallback chain; each entry is `providerType` or `providerType/model`.

teaser.description: Drafted teaser fields, shaped by the content type's `teaser_schema` (default contract: `headline` ≤ 110 chars, `description` ≤ 500) — so the properties vary per type. On a failed run this is the last attempt's output, or the raw model text when it was not JSON.

valid.description: Whether `teaser` validated against the teaser schema (AJV, one feedback retry).

errors.description: AJV errors from the last attempt; present only when `valid` is false.

totalTokens.description: Total tokens billed for the call.

model.description: Transcription model that produced the text.

language.description: Detected or requested source language, when the provider reports it.

translations.description: Plain-text translations keyed by target locale (present when `text` was given).

richTextTranslations.description: Rich-text translations keyed by target locale (present when `richText` was given). Each value is a ProseMirror/TipTap `doc` node with the original structure, marks, and attributes preserved.

jobId.description: Batch job id — returned instead of translations when the request carried a `contentId` (the content-wide translation runs as a `pro_ai_jobs` job; poll `GET /pro/ai/jobs/{id}`).

provenance.description: Where the translation ran; absent on the batch-job path.

from.description: Start of the window actually used (defaults to 30 days ago).

to.description: End of the window actually used (defaults to now).

tokens.description: Prompt + completion tokens on this day.

key.description: Bucket key — the caller or model id; '?' when the log row had none.

tokens.description: Prompt + completion tokens in this bucket.

cost.description: Summed cost in the instance currency (numeric — coerced to a JS number).

redacted.description: Calls whose payload was PII-redacted before egress.

fallbacks.description: Calls that fell back to a non-preferred provider.

text.description: The generated text for the requested action (alt text, caption, OCR, tags, description).

model.description: Vision model that produced the text.

original.description: The input text, verbatim — for a diff preview against `result`. Never auto-applied.

result.description: Primary suggestion (full replacement text, or the first option for list actions).

suggestions.description: All parsed options for list actions (`headline`, `social`).
